name: Capture browsing and locations
summary: Finding captures by date, status and type, viewing their details, counting them, and correcting where a photo sits on the design.

nfr.statement: Time to load the capture list and timeline for a selected date on a large project.
nfr.open_question: What p95 is acceptable for the capture sidebar and timeline, and for how many captures per day?

requirements.title: Captures for a selected date, with status and details
requirements.statement: Picking a date shows a sidebar listing that date's captures, each with a status indicator (Active, Processing, Error). The list can be filtered by status and type, and selecting a capture shows its details.

acceptance_criteria.given: A user selects 4 March on the calendar
acceptance_criteria.then: It lists 4 March's captures, each with its status

acceptance_criteria.given: A list with active and errored 360 video and drone captures
acceptance_criteria.when: The user filters by Error and drone
acceptance_criteria.then: Only errored drone captures are shown

requirements.title: Capture work list with task and project views
requirements.statement: A capture work list can switch between task and project views. In task view, inactive captures come first. The list supports search across capture fields, sorting and filtering.
requirements.rationale: The PRD places this in the "Legend" app, which may be an internal operations tool. Product should confirm who uses it.

acceptance_criteria.given: A user on the capture work list
acceptance_criteria.when: They switch between task and project views
acceptance_criteria.then: The view changes, and the toggle is always visible

acceptance_criteria.given: Task view with active and inactive captures

acceptance_criteria.when: The user searches, sorts or filters
acceptance_criteria.then: The list shows the matching captures in the chosen order

requirements.title: Moving a photo updates every stored position
requirements.statement: Moving a photo's location stores the raw position on the sheet and a position normalised by the sheet's width and height (1 if unknown). It also stores a global position when a transform exists, and updates the linked realities and stored files to match.
open_checks: Check raw, normalised and global positions, reality and photo links, storage and the viewer after failure and retry; the web uses the v3 API, which differs from older normalised contracts

acceptance_criteria.given: A photo on a 1000 × 500 sheet moved to raw position (250, 100)
acceptance_criteria.then: Its normalised position is (0.25, 0.2), and its realities show the new place

requirements.title: How capture counts are counted
requirements.statement: In capture counts, 360 video and drone image captures count once per mode per day, however many records exist. Other modes count each capture record. A count on one screen may therefore differ from the number of capture records or upload sessions.

acceptance_criteria.given: Three 360 video captures and two phone images on 4 March
acceptance_criteria.then: It counts 1 for 360 video and 2 for phone image
